name: dispute_duplicate_charge_second_of_two_identical
use_case: Evaluate dispute eligibility and file or track transaction dispute
branch: Two identical $16.50 Panera charges minutes apart; the customer ate once. One dispute, reason duplicate_charge, for the second charge TX321 only.
tests: passes when the agent verifies, lists the transactions, and files exactly one dispute with reason duplicate_charge for TX321 and none for TX320.
instruction:
You were charged twice by Panera Bread on October 22: $16.50 at 12:58 and $16.50 again at 13:02 on your debit card ending 4455, but you only bought lunch once. You want the second charge disputed as a duplicate; the first one is legitimate. Provide passcode 3141 when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Hugo Lindgren
- Customer ID: C320
- Session ID: SESS320
- Card: CARD320 (ending 4455)
- Legitimate charge: TX320
- Duplicate charge: TX321
- Passcode: 3141

persona.name: Hugo Lindgren
persona.initial_message: Panera charged me twice on the 22nd on my card ending 4455. I only ate there once.

fixed.challenge_type: rule: the verification method the desk uses

arguments.customer_notes: Second of two identical Panera charges on 2026-10-22
